name: InkSalah
summary: Turn reTerminal Sticky into an offline-first prayer-window display with native touch settings.
description: InkSalah is an offline-first Salah companion for reTerminal Sticky. It calculates Fajr, Sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha, and optional Qiyam locally, showing the current prayer window and remaining time. Version 0.1.1 adds Roboto typography, connected Arabic labels, AM/PM times, and distinct portrait and landscape arch layouts. Native touch settings, direct location and settings shortcuts, Wi-Fi onboarding, reminders, and a retained deep-sleep display keep daily use simple.

compatibility.notes: Registry package 0.1.2 adds SSD1677/SSD2677 detection and GT911 startup fixes; the tested binary still reports application 0.1.1. Final-package SSD1677 setup/touch passed; SSD2677 had nine successful startup resets. Full new-screen interaction acceptance is still pending.

assets.previewAlt: InkSalah portrait interface on reTerminal Sticky showing the Asr prayer window and daily times in Dongguan

notes.title: Device connection
notes.description: Connect reTerminal Sticky with a USB-C data cable and use desktop Chrome or Edge.

notes.title: Clean installation
notes.description: Accept the erase prompt when moving from another firmware so InkSalah can create a clean settings store.

notes.title: Wi-Fi onboarding
notes.description: On first boot, connect a phone to the Sticky-Salah setup network, choose a nearby Wi-Fi network, and complete the captive setup page.

notes.title: Prayer settings
notes.description: Confirm location and time zone on the device, then choose the calculation method, Asr school, per-time adjustments, reminder, and Qiyam display.

notes.title: Screen compatibility update
notes.description: Install package 0.1.2 for automatic SSD1677/SSD2677 detection. The application still reports 0.1.1; package 0.1.2 identifies the tested screen/touch fixes. See the project README for the tested hardware and remaining acceptance checks.
